result.summary: The environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked crossings at the intersection. Significant overgrown vegetation at the corner creates a major visual obstruction, hindering sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation at the corner completely blocks the view of pedestrians or vehicles entering the main roadway from the side path/alley.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and intersection area

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes and trees at the corner to restore clear sight triangles for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to designate legal crossing points and alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

result.summary: This is a residential street with multi-family housing and sidewalks, but it lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The presence of large parked vehicles, including a boat trailer, creates significant sightline obstructions for anyone attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: A large truck and boat trailer parked along the curb significantly block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signage indicating where pedestrians should cross this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with well-maintained sidewalks and modern curb ramps featuring tactile warning pads. However, the environment lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control signs for the immediate intersection, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible for the approaching traffic, which may lead to higher speeds and failure to yield to pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate vehicle right-of-way and reduce speeds at the residential intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with row houses and continuous sidewalks. A marked crosswalk is present across the side street, but markings are faded and there is a lack of active traffic control or pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the corner property may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers turning onto the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Upgrades
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes) on the existing curb ramps for accessibility.
